data.content_ref: inline:The 'Synchronization Resonance' failure mode in large services (SRC_005) integrates with the 'Redundancy Paradox' (SRC_004) by providing the specific physical mechanism—systemic oscillations—through which the increased complexity of the synchronization layer manifests as a correlated failure. This relation is refuted if 'Synchronization Resonance' can occur in decentralized networks without a global synchronization layer.
